note: Holmes County MS has zoning authority over unincorporated land (per mississippistateauthority.com), but no zoning district layer is published. The county's public GIS (agdonline Holmes_Service FeatureServer, used by the tscmaps parcel viewer) has parcels and legislative districts only, with no zoning field. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the county, Durant and Lexington web presence found no queryable zoning districts service. Commercial parcel vendors mention zoning codes but are not official or queryable.
